text:
Ravi: Heads-up 1: the rules editor feels unstable when dragging items deep in a stack. Items snap unpredictably and the Preview pane keeps re-running sim while Im mid-drag. Maya: Repro'd. On my machine the dragged item jumps several positions after a short pause. I think virtualization + our snap math is fighting the mouse/keyboard input. Priya: UX idea: pause preview while a reorder gesture is active and show a small non-modal overlay: 'Preview paused while editing rules'. Avoids noisy toasts/errors while editing. Noah: Agree on pause. Also keyboard users need a clear announcement after a move. Current SR text is just 'Change saved' which is useless. Better: 'Rule "Allow-Login" moved to position 4 of 10'. Marco: FYI backend sim sometimes returns 202 then 200 as it warms caches. Frontend treats non-200 as error which is why you see a flash of red. We should interpret 202 as "processing" and show spinner + optimistic UI. a11y-bot: Scan results: drag handle contrast 2.6:1 (fail). Interactive target 16px (fail). Recommend at least 44px hit area and visible focus indicator. Add aria-grabbed and aria-dropeffect where applicable. Priya: Copy suggestions for failures: instead of 'Invalid rule order' use 'Unable to apply order check for circular dependencies or locked rules.' Short variant for toast: 'Order not saved resolve dependencies.' Maya: Microinteraction: reduce snap threshold, add a 120ms debounce before applying the reorder to server, and animate the list with a quick fade/translate so it's less jarring. Ravi: Quick keyboard affordance thought: show Move Up / Move Down chevrons when a row is focused, with aria-labels and a tooltip that shows the hotkey (Alt+Shift+Up / Alt+Shift+Down). Also ensure Space/Enter triggers move and announces new position. Marco: I'll change the client to accept 202 as "in-progress" and surface a small inline spinner next to the Preview title. Also add a client-side retry: poll once after 1s, then fallback to showing the final error if 200 never arrives. Noah: Example SR live region snippet I can add to the pattern library: 
<div id="rule-move-live" aria-live="polite" class="sr-only">Moved rule \"Allow-Login\" to position 4 of 10</div>
Priya: Thanks. Who wants the tickets? I'll own the copy updates and keyboard guidance. @Maya can you do the microinteraction mocks (fade + lowered snap)? @Marco please do the API ack handling change. Maya: Happy to mock. Quick ask: can we prioritize the a11y fixes (handle hit target + focus ring) before the visuals? Small perf cost but big usability win. a11y-bot: Adding recommended checklist: increase hit target to 44px; ensure focus-visible contrast >= 3:1; provide aria-live announcement after keyboard reorder; mark drag handle role="button" and include aria-label. Ravi: Solid. Let's sync Wed 9am PT if needed. Dropping links to current issue and a short recording. Thanks all. :sparkles:
